snippet.title: Hyper Paddle Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782400/Hyper_Paddle/
After many months of preparation, here is the trailer for my first Steam game, Hyper Paddle!

Hyper Paddle is a colorful brick breaker inspired by older arcade classics with modern visual effects.  The game is divided into multiple worlds, each themed after a different color, including underwater, nature, and a hive.  Different power-ups allow quickly cutting through hundreds of bricks.  Difficult bosses provide a fun but challenging change up to this brick breaker game.

Hyper Paddle is available to wishlist on Steam, any and all support is greatly appreciated!
